site.summary: greengrove-clone Fictional pet insurance "GreenGrove" marketing site, including a 6-step quote wizard. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Landing page: hand-drawn dog illustration hero + 3 value props + customer review cards + FAQ entry | | `quote.html` | 6-step quote wizard: 1 pet type (6 icon cards) / 2 breed (200+ dogs, 60+ cats, other species auto-switched ARIA combobox with searchable dropdown — keyboard up/down/Enter/Esc) / 3 age (year/month toggle + stepper) / 4 pre-existing conditions (19 chip multi-select + None toggle) / 5 three tier cards (Sprout / Sapling / Oak) + deductible dropdown + collapsible side-by-side comparison table + live per-tier quote / 6 quote summary (monthly fee + annual total + inclusions + 14-day price lock mock); top 6-step dot indicator allows jumping back; floating Back / Continue bar | | `faq.html` | 12 common-question `<details>` accordion |

run_plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the GreenGrove pet insurance site, focusing on the 6-step quote wizard, adjacent flows (claims, FAQ), and recovery paths across desktop and mobile viewports.
run_plan.summary: The run will start by assessing the landing page and navigating to the primary 6-step quote wizard, validating complex interactions like the ARIA combobox, age toggles, and tier comparisons. It will then test form validation and recovery on the claims page, followed by evaluating the FAQ accordion. Finally, critical flows will be re-validated on a mobile viewport to check responsiveness and tap-target issues identified in the prescan.
assumptions: The quote wizard allows non-linear navigation via the 6-step dot indicator to test backward/forward jumps.
The ARIA combobox for breed selection supports keyboard navigation (up/down/Enter/Esc) and filtering.
The claims form will validate required fields and file upload constraints when submitted.
The FAQ page uses native or custom <details> elements that can be toggled open and closed.
risk_hotspots: quote.html: ARIA combobox for breed selection (keyboard accessibility, filtering logic, 200+ items)
quote.html: Multi-select chips for pre-existing conditions (state management, 'None' toggle logic)
quote.html: Tier comparison table and live quote calculation (collapsible UI, dynamic pricing updates)
claims.html: Form validation and file upload interaction
All pages: Small tap targets on navigation links (especially 'FAQ' at 28x22px and 'Claims' at 43x22px)
